_note: Candidate registry for New Hampshire 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (New Hampshire Secretary of State, Elections Division, Candidate List w/ Address (2026 General Election Candidates), dated 09/17/2026, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: New Hampshire Secretary of State, Elections Division, Candidate List w/ Address (2026 General Election Candidates), dated 09/17/2026 (https://mm.nh.gov/files/uploads/sos/docs/2026-ge-candidate-list.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
